business_summary: Tibet Urban Development and Investment Co.,LTD, together with its subsidiaries, develops, operates, manages, and sells real estate properties in China. The company is also involved in the mining investment business; leasing and financing activities; and management of outlets, as well as operates a hotel. In addition, it provides sales agencies, urban renewal, real estate brokerage, catering, guestrooms, and food and beverage services, as well as operates shopping mall. Tibet Urban Development and Investment Co.,LTD was formerly known as Tibet Jinzhu Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Lhasa, China.
business_summary_ko: Tibet Urban Development and Investment Co.,LTD는 자회사와 함께 중국의 부동산을 개발, 운영, 관리 및 판매합니다. 회사는 광산 투자 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 임대 및 금융 활동; 아울렛 관리, 호텔 운영 등을 담당하고 있습니다. 또한, 판매 대리점, 도시 재개발, 부동산 중개, 케이터링, 객실, 식음료 서비스를 제공하고 쇼핑몰을 운영합니다. Tibet Urban Development and Investment Co.,LTD는 이전에 Tibet Jinzhu Co., Ltd.로 알려져 있었습니다. 이 회사는 1996년에 설립되었으며 중국 라사에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
